placements.role: Plans HBM advanced-packaging capacity in Singapore, with operations scheduled to begin in 2026 and meaningful capacity expansion beginning in 2027; this placement does not claim the new facility is currently operating.

role_evidence.claim: Micron's official groundbreaking release says the new Singapore HBM advanced-packaging facility is scheduled to begin operations in 2026 and meaningfully expand Micron's total advanced-packaging capacity beginning in calendar 2027.
role_evidence.source_name: Micron Singapore HBM advanced-packaging groundbreaking release

placements.role: Designs and volume-manufactures high-bandwidth memory for AI accelerators.

role_evidence.claim: Micron says its HBM4 36GB 12H entered high-volume production and volume shipment for NVIDIA Vera Rubin in the first quarter of 2026.

business_summary: Micron Technology, Inc. is a NASDAQ-listed memory manufacturer: DRAM, NAND and, for this chain, high-bandwidth memory stacked and packaged for AI accelerators. It is a cyclical commodity producer that the AI cycle has temporarily repriced as a specialty supplier, which is visible in the numbers: fiscal 2023 revenue was 15.5 billion dollars with a 5.8 billion dollar loss, fiscal 2025 revenue was 37.4 billion dollars with 8.5 billion dollars of net income.

exposure_summary.narrative: Two placements. hbm-memory (position 8, heat CROWDED, crowdedness 78) is the direct one and is backed by Micron's own dated release putting HBM4 36GB 12H into high-volume production for NVIDIA Vera Rubin. advanced-packaging (position 7, heat EMERGING) is the weaker of the two and the mapping says so explicitly: the placement rests on the Singapore HBM advanced-packaging facility, which the issuer's own groundbreaking release schedules to begin operations in 2026 and to expand capacity meaningfully only from calendar 2027. It is a planned facility, not an operating one, and the placement record states that limitation itself.

disclosed_revenue_exposure.basis: Micron reports by business unit and by product family, not by AI end market, so no disclosed percentage of revenue attributable to AI accelerators or to advanced packaging exists in a source read this run.

piotroski.basis: piotroski F-score is unavailable for Micron: data/market/MU.json quality.piotroski reports state PENDING_DATA with all 9 of 9 inputs found but 0 common fiscal periods across them, because the long_term_debt series ends at fiscal 2012 while the rest run to fiscal 2025, and the change legs need at least two shared periods.

The share count is official SEC companyfacts; the close 932.86 of 2026-08-28 is the repo's own market plane, not an issuer document. price_to_earnings.basis: Market capitalization 1046668920000 divided by fiscal year 2025-08-28 GAAP net income 8539000000. The share count is official SEC companyfacts; the close 932.86 of 2026-08-28 is the repo's own market plane, not an issuer document.

ev_to_sales.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/MU.json quality.derived.enterprise_value over SEC companyfacts revenue
ev_to_sales.basis: Enterprise value 1024940920000 divided by fiscal year 2025-08-28 revenue 37378000000. Enterprise value is below market capitalization because the store nets 24995000000 of cash against a debt figure it does not currently hold, which is the same concept gap that NULLs net debt to EBITDA on this profile; the ratio is therefore a lower bound, not a settled figure.

implied_fcf_cagr.basis: reverse-DCF implied FCF CAGR is unavailable for Micron: data/market/MU.json quality.reverse_dcf reports state OUT_OF_RANGE with the reason that the price implies growth above a 100% CAGR, so the bisection does not return a meaningful solve on base free cash flow 1668000000 against enterprise value 1024940920000. That is itself a finding about how much is priced in.

horizon_spread.basis: reverse-DCF horizon spread cannot be computed for Micron because the base implied FCF CAGR solve is OUT_OF_RANGE, so there is no set of per-horizon solves to take a spread across.

crowdedness_caveats: data/market/MU.json carries no pcs block, so analyst count and institutional ownership were not measured for this issuer this run.

hbm-memory carries the highest crowdedness score of the four links this batch touches: 78, verdict CROWDED (data/chains/ai-infrastructure.json). Micron's direct placement is on the crowded link and its weaker placement is on the less crowded one.
The 52-week range is 118.48 to 1213.5601 against a 932.86 close. A stock that has moved roughly eight-fold inside a year is not an un-crowded position.

Price to sales of 28 and price to earnings of 123 on a memory manufacturer are the clearest crowdedness reading available here: the market is not pricing Micron as a cyclical commodity producer, and the reverse DCF cannot even solve inside a 100% CAGR bound.

catalysts.claim: Micron's own dated release says HBM4 36GB 12H entered high-volume production and volume shipment for NVIDIA Vera Rubin in the first quarter of 2026, which is a dated commitment on the hbm-memory placement rather than a roadmap statement.
Operating margin recovered to 26.1% in fiscal 2025 from an operating loss of 5745000000 in fiscal 2023, so the cycle turn is in the reported numbers and not only in guidance.

data_gaps: Three canonical fields are NULL: net_debt_to_ebitda, piotroski and beneish_state, plus both reverse_dcf fields. Each names its own cause in its basis.

The root cause of the leverage and quality NULLs is a companyfacts concept-coverage gap rather than a stale fetch: data/market/MU.json reports coverage 20 of 20 annual fields, but long_term_debt ends at fiscal 2012-08-30, ppe_net at fiscal 2019-08-29 and total_debt carries one instant dated 2013-05-30. A plain fundamentals refresh may well return the same series, so this is queued as a request and also captured to the backlog as a fetch-plane defect rather than treated as a transient gap.

This profile is COMPLETE with an unestablished earnings-quality state, which is the one place this batch's completion rule was not applied cleanly. The file committed at d6e6c4d asserted COMPLETE for this issuer on Vertiv's numbers; check_profile preservation refuses a regression from COMPLETE, so this repair corrects every number and leaves the status where HEAD put it rather than fighting the gate. The three NULL fields bar O1 promotion on their own, so no selection can act on the gap.
No AI revenue percentage is disclosed by the issuer, so the share of revenue attributable to this chain is unknown.

data/edgar/docs/MU.json does not exist, so no filing document was available locally to quote verbatim; both catalyst quotes above are the issuer's own dated releases named in the mapping placement evidence, not filing text read this run.

Completion rule applied uniformly across this batch: a profile is COMPLETE when revenue, growth, margins, cash conversion and valuation all resolve to sourced numbers AND the earnings-quality state can be established. A profile whose earnings-quality state cannot be established, or which has no fundamentals at all, is BLOCKED. Individual NULL fields are permitted on a COMPLETE profile where the input is genuinely absent or the computation is not meaningful, and each such NULL blocks O1 promotion on its own.

disposition.basis: Real, dated, issuer-sourced exposure on the hbm-memory link and a measured revenue, margin and cash-conversion record. Deferred rather than retained because the two things a dive would most need are the two that are missing: an earnings-quality state on a violent cyclical recovery, and a leverage reading. Both are blocked by a fetch-plane concept gap, not by the issuer. Revisit when the queued fundamentals and quality rows fulfil.

confidence_audit.basis: Counts cover the canonical metric fields only. VERIFIED is a figure read directly off SEC companyfacts as reported. INFERRED is computed from SEC companyfacts with the derivation named in its basis; where a market price enters the computation the basis says so. There is no SPECULATIVE figure because the reverse-DCF solve did not return. NULL is a field looked for and not found: five of thirteen here, which is the honest measure of this profile.

notes: Profiles are medium-depth reusable research. This file carries no final verdict, no entry zone and no red team; those belong to the deep-dive stage.
